highlights.title: Borussia Dortmund cede à pressão da torcida e rompe com a Rheinmetall
highlights.summary: Após protestos da segunda maior torcida alemã, clube rescinde contrato de patrocínio com a maior fabricante de armas da Alemanha. Time não é o primeiro da Bundesliga a sofrer conflito entre interesses comerciais e fãs.

highlights.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
highlights.summary: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

highlights.summary: Daniel Slaviero apresentou plano de investimentos da companhia para investidores na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York

highlights.title: What impact will the Shenzhen summit have on the US-China trade war?
highlights.summary: Despite warm words between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen Thursday, the simmering trade war between Washington and Beijing still looks to be no closer to resolution.
